name: Pass without Trace
summary: Gives you and chosen creatures in a 30-foot aura +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

stats.effect: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.
